Metrics.Name: intune.intent.count
Metrics.Description: Intune template-based device management intents, by migration status. An intent already represented as a Settings Catalog configurationPolicy (migrating, matched by templateReference) is excluded here to avoid double-counting against intune.settings_catalog.policy.count.

Metrics.Name: intune.intent.devices
Metrics.Description: Per-intent device compliance status from deviceStateSummary, by intent and compliance status.

Metrics.Name: intune.security_baseline.devices
Metrics.Description: Per-security-baseline device state from deviceStateSummary, by baseline and state.

Metrics.Name: intune.settings_catalog.policy.count
Metrics.Description: Intune Settings Catalog configuration policy count, by platform, technology, and template family.
